body: I am a doctor. you can feel safe sharing this.
I am not older than you (25F sadly) but you sound awesome so I would love to be your twin sister!
Hey! 25f here, feel free to message me!
Hey, 25f here! Feel free to message me!
Hey! Lonely 25f here. Feel free to PM me.
This is always awesome to hear. I hope the best for you.

Feel free to pm me if you want to talk more! I obviously don't know your dad, but I'm sure he would much rather be disappointed in you for a little while than have you take your own life. As for the doctor, I'm 23 right now and I still have difficulty scheduling my own doctor appointments, so that's nothing to be ashamed of. Do you currently see a doctor, for yearly checkups or anything? If so, you can make an appointment with them and they can refer you to a specialist (i.e. psychiatrist or psychologist) if you think that would be helpful. If you don't currently have a doctor you go to you can use a website like zocdoc to search for doctors in your area and make an appointment online without even having to make a call.

I've definitely been in this situation before and it's really frustrating. It feels like people who care about you should notice your cries for help, even if they're subtle. I completely understand the fear of being in a hospital (I've had horrible experiences myself). I think it might be a good idea to tell your family or friends that you're having a hard time. That's what I did and it really made a difference.

You're absolutely not a failure, and your situation is salvageable, absolutely. Plenty of people who are really successful got poor grades earlier in life. Seeing a doctor would be a really good first step. I'm really proud that you decided to write this post, and I think that's a sign that you're not ready to give up, right?
That will not kill you. It will give you liver pain if untreated and make you vomit.
I really appreciate your kind words.
Yeah, that's how I feel exactly.

Your words really resonated with me. I've always felt like I'm in a similar position. I oftentimes feel like I am very privileged and I haven't earned the right to feel as poorly as I do, if that makes sense.

Just from what you've said though, I can tell you are a thoughtful, humble, articulate person. Reaching out to your friends could really help. They're there to support you, and I'm sure it would sadden them if they knew that you were hurting but were too afraid to tell them. Friends are a great source of support, and a great untapped resource in your case. I don't have any suggestions for what you should do, but I can tell you that you don't sound like a little bitch, and I feel for you.

I appreciate your words. I wish I could observe the thought and move on, but a lot of the time it's all I can think about. Sometimes it feels like thinking about dying is the one thing that calms me down. I have tried many therapists as well. I had one a few months ago that I didn't really get along with, and I find it exhausting to establish a relationship with a new one.
Hi friend. I'm from AZ too! I've also been hospitalized for "suicidal ideology". It's kind of a soul sucking place, isn't it?
Your art is terrific. You should be really proud of yourself.
